recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a young child in full safety gear riding a dark pony in a fenced outdoor arena, featuring a soft warm-toned gradient overlay at the bottom that transitions into clean sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment between the rider and the centered text
Contrast between the sharp detail of the rider and the soft atmospheric haze at the bottom
Color harmony between the pony's dark coat and the black typography
coreInvariants: Safety gear including helmet and protective vest
Lush green foliage in the upper third
Warm sepia-toned gradient at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The rider and pony are centrally located, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The child's face and helmet serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the child's face, moves down the pony's body, and settles on the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper foliage and the lower sandy arena provide breathing room for the central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Natural greens and browns from the outdoor setting.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White from the fence and the child's grey shirt provide mid-tone contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm golden-brown gradient at the bottom and red accents on the pony's tack.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted natural saturation with a high-value haze at the bottom to facilitate text legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded terminals for a friendly tone

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for clarity and simplicity.
graphicDevices: Warm-toned radial or linear gradient overlay at the bottom edge

candidateDirections.reason: Humanist qualities match the friendly, educational tone.
High legibility and clean modern look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A photo of a child in a helmet and safety vest riding a dark pony in a fenced arena with green trees behind. Apply a soft, warm golden-brown gradient haze to the bottom 25% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place centered humanist sans-serif text in black over the hazy area at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Gradient provides enough contrast for black text
Child's safety gear is clearly visible
Pony is facing forward/slightly toward the viewer

mustRedesign: Any specific brand logos on the helmet or vest
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pony has four legs visible or implied by movement
Check that the helmet strap is correctly positioned under the chin
Verify the text does not overlap the pony's hooves
Confirm the color of the gradient feels warm and sun-drenched
recipe.reuseFormula: Central subject (rider/animal) + background fence + bottom gradient overlay + centered humanist sans-serif text.
